primary_success_criterion: A must beat R_deranged AND R_domain AND R_same (corrected CI lower bound > 0.5), survive multiplicity correction, and avoid unacceptable correctness degradation (T4)

correctness_tracking.note: T4 correctness degradation reported separately regardless of creative wins
